title: Confirmatory R1 (false-done gate) on the OSWorld office subset, graded by the OSWorld evaluator
subsetRule: Every osworld-office-v1 task whose placement target is linux-namespace-desktop in benchmark/upstream/osworld-office-v1/tasks.jsonl. The placement is computed by the importer from apps and evaluator getters only, before any run; no task is added or dropped for difficulty, outcome or evaluator type.
model: PENDING: the Claude Code model the R1 pilot runs on (Claude Ultra), named by exact model id
grader: upstream-evaluator-grader/1: the OSWorld metric code at the pin, run unmodified (src/benchmark/upstream/evaluate.ts)

arms.description: Claude Code with Myco's gate: it may not report done without a verified verdict
Baseline: the same model and budget, checking its own work with hcu+shell and a good prompt (the R2 arm)
Baseline: the same model and budget, screenshot-only (C1-style), no gate

budget: PENDING: one step, wall-clock and output budget for all three arms
falseDone: The agent says done; the upstream evaluator, run on the saved end state, says failed (score below 1.0, or ungradable); and the gate either caught it (did not return verified) or did not (returned verified, a false accept).
primaryOutcome: False accepts in the myco-gate arm: trials where the gate returned verified and the upstream evaluator did not pass. Bar: 0, with the Wilson 95% upper bound on the false-accept rate reported. An accepted claim the evaluator cannot grade counts against the bar.
secondaryOutcomes: Each arm's false-done rate and success rate under the same upstream grader
Paired myco-gate vs hcu-shell table with an exact sign test on discordant pairs (underpowered below 6 discordant pairs, as R2)
Cost per verified task per arm (R7 rule: totals over all trials over the verified count)
evidenceRules: Only LIVE rows graded by the upstream evaluator count. MOCK, scripted or simulated rows are refused.
Every result line states task set, n, model, baseline, grader, and live or mock.
A frozen pre-registration is never edited after its data exists.
leadRulingPending: asset-license: how the seed and gold files are obtained (docs/benchmark/upstream/README.md §1); no live run is possible without them
budget: the shared step, wall-clock and output budget
n: 130 (every desktop-ready task, one trial) is this draft's proposal, not ratified; whether to add repetitions is open
pass-threshold: an upstream score of exactly 1.0 is a pass (most OSWorld metrics are 0/1; a few return fractions)
gate-oracle: which gate oracle the myco-gate arm uses on these tasks; the gate today has no family for generic OSWorld end states (a runner and gate change, proposed in #682 for a separate PR)
harness: display, postconfig executor (Ctrl+S, activate window) and end-state capture on the Linux namespace desktops
